slices.title: 闭合 current design 的首个架构或历史硬阻塞
slices.action: 从 current receipt 暴露的 blocker head 中只选择一个事务缺口，完成正向、compile-success mutation 与同 design-id 重绑定。
required_evidence: current blocker ID and exact design-id
focused positive and compile-success negative
updated current receipt with no borrowed sibling PASS
success_conditions: selected blocker is CLOSED on the live design-id
all original and mutation terminal markers are exact
rollback_conditions: focused correctness or mutation oracle fails
forbidden_claims: PPA promotion
whole architecture closure from one blocker

slices.title: 建立 current design 的 PERF_BASELINE
slices.action: 在 current correctness/architecture receipt 闭合后，冻结 CoreMark/Dhrystone ROI、simulator 与 counter contract，生成三次 bit-exact baseline。
required_evidence: current ARCH_STABLE input binding
three independent raw logs per workload
stats-off/on noninterference and counter conservation
success_conditions: canonical PERF_BASELINE verifies on live design-id
rollback_conditions: workload, ROI, simulator or counter identity drifts
forbidden_claims: PPA qualified
global workload representativeness

slices.title: 重建 current design 的 CPI bottleneck census
slices.action: 从 canonical PERF_BASELINE 重建 census，并隔离旧 design-id 的 current 命名文件。
required_evidence: baseline path, size and SHA-256
live design-id
canonical census verify PASS
success_conditions: census design-id equals live design-id
census performance_baseline SHA equals canonical baseline
forbidden_claims: causal bottleneck proven
RTL candidate authorized

slices.title: 在 current design 上完成 LSU→AXI owner-timing A/B
slices.domain: RV64 LSU and AXI transaction timing
slices.action: 冻结 workload、ROI、simulator 和 latency profile，测量 request admission、inflight occupancy、AW/W→B、reservation 与 translation owner 区间。
required_evidence: CoreMark and Dhrystone image path, SHA-256 and size from the canonical v3 baseline manifest
three stats-off/on repetitions for CoreMark and Dhrystone
owner identity, interval and occupancy conservation
zero overflow, invalid event and observer interference
fail-closed status, hash and cleanup markers
success_conditions: current design-id owner-timing receipt verifies
H1 through H4 receive discriminating observations
rollback_conditions: identity, counter stack or benchmark terminal changes under instrumentation
forbidden_claims: buffer depth or B-channel RTL candidate already wins
PPA qualified
promotion eligible

slices.title: 从合格 owner-timing receipt 选择唯一因果假设
slices.action: 比较事务频率、固定分箱时长、ROB-head 相关性和独立工作重叠；主要解释仍并列时输出研究缺口而不授权 RTL。
required_evidence: hypothesis-to-channel matrix
alternative explanation rejection or explicit ambiguity
canonical CPI census or dedicated causal-authority receipt binding
success_conditions: exactly one causal_hypothesis enters a canonical authority or decision is RESEARCH_REQUIRED
rollback_conditions: owner timing receipt is stale or non-conserving
forbidden_claims: causal selection from residency percentage alone

slices.title: 受控测量工作负载对 AXI B 返回延迟的敏感度
slices.domain: RV64 store terminal and peer memory progress
slices.action: 保持 production RTL、PC-bounded image、复位、计数器和终端合同不变，仅以测试配置改变 memory slave 的 AW/W→B 返回延迟；比较 CoreMark 与 Dhrystone 的 cycles/retired、B 事务数和逐拍斜率，以解耦 H1 固定延迟和 H2 单 owner 并发限制。
required_evidence: default and controlled-added B-delay configurations with one exact simulator identity
three bit-exact repetitions per workload and delay point
unchanged retired count, terminal markers, assertion count and owner conservation
cycles-per-B-delay slope with uncertainty and H1/H2 decision rule
success_conditions: workload cycle sensitivity to B delay is measured independently of transaction frequency
exactly one H1/H2 interpretation is authorized or a narrower research gap is emitted
rollback_conditions: retired count, architectural terminal, assertion or non-B device behavior changes
test configuration leaks into production RTL semantics
forbidden_claims: diagnostic device-latency intervention is a production CPI result
promotion or PPA qualification from this measurement

slices.title: 映射 canonical AW/W→B 路径并定义最小可回退候选
slices.domain: RV64 store completion and AXI B response timing
slices.action: 沿 current NpcSimTop 实际 elaborated 路径逐周期映射 AW/W 接收、slave B 生成、bridge B 接收与 store terminal，区分固定设备响应拍和核内可隐藏等待；只定义一个保持精确异常与退休语义的可回退候选或明确 GAP，本切片不修改 production RTL。
required_evidence: cycle-exact canonical AW/W-to-B and B-to-store-terminal map
measured workload-cycle bounds derived from the controlled B-delay slopes
one reversible candidate invariant or one explicit no-safe-candidate GAP
error response, downstream backpressure, flush and replay counterexamples
success_conditions: exactly one production candidate is specified without changing RTL, or a narrower GAP is recorded
candidate retains store retirement, B terminal and SLVERR/DECERR precision
rollback_conditions: canonical elaborated path differs from the analyzed source path
candidate requires early store retirement or suppressed B completion
forbidden_claims: production CPI gain from diagnostic B-delay sensitivity alone
dropping or coalescing B terminal events
weakening SLVERR, DECERR, flush, replay or RTL assertion contracts
PPA qualification or promotion

slices.title: 建立 current design 的参考综合与 STA 头寸
slices.action: 在冻结的 5 ns、library、macro inventory、SDC、seed 和 threads 下完成至少两次 fresh synth/STA，形成当前设计的 area/slack 参考。
required_evidence: two fresh netlists and exact tool/config binding
WNS, TNS, violating paths, loops and worst path members
same-cohort logic area and explicit macro qualification
success_conditions: current design has a repeatable P/A + timing reference
unqualified power remains explicitly unqualified
rollback_conditions: netlist, path set or constraints are not repeatable
forbidden_claims: final three-axis champion from vectorless or macro-zero power

slices.title: 聚类 current 5 ns 违例路径并定义最小可回退时序候选
slices.action: 对两轮 bit-exact mapped netlist 的 top-40 路径按 startpoint、endpoint、共享组合锥和 RTL owner 聚类，区分主导路径族与旁支，只定义一个保持 CPI、owner/holder、flush/replay 和精确异常合同的可回退时序候选或明确 GAP；本切片不修改 production RTL。
required_evidence: two-run exact top-40 path-member identity and setup-warning closure
path-family counts with shared startpoint, endpoint and RTL owner mapping
one minimal reversible timing candidate invariant or one explicit no-safe-candidate GAP
CPI, area, owner/holder, flush/replay and exception counterexamples
success_conditions: one dominant physical proxy path family is distinguished from secondary families
the next candidate has an exact register-cut or logic-cone objective without weakening the 5 ns hard gate
rollback_conditions: path reports or source mapping are not repeatable
the proposed cut changes architectural terminal or owner lifetime semantics
forbidden_claims: a negative WNS reference is an accepted PPA baseline
vectorless power is qualified power
production RTL authorization or promotion from path clustering alone

slices.title: 可回退地隐藏 AW/W→B 完成等待
slices.domain: RV64 store retirement and AXI B completion
slices.action: 在不提前退休 store、不删除 B terminal 且保持精确 SLVERR/DECERR 的前提下，实验独立事务重叠机制。
required_evidence: candidate objective observation with confidence interval
store/B-response directed positive and negative
full performance A/B plus quick synth/STA
success_conditions: CPI benefit survives per-workload floor
5 ns hard timing gate is not spent
rollback_conditions: timing or area compensation path is absent
forbidden_claims: promotion from an intermediate checkpoint

slices.title: 可回退地增加 LSU/bridge 写事务并发
slices.domain: RV64 LSU admission and AXI outstanding
slices.action: 只在 H2 被 owner/occupancy 证据支持后实验最小并发增量，并保持 request owner、flush/cancel 与 B terminal 合同。
required_evidence: candidate objective observation with confidence interval
outstanding capacity and backpressure directed tests
full performance A/B plus quick synth/STA
success_conditions: independent memory overlap increases
CPI gain is not bought with a timing violation
rollback_conditions: downstream backpressure remains the limiting cause
forbidden_claims: more entries imply more throughput without measured overlap

slices.title: 可回退地降低 reservation/translation 前请求驻留
slices.domain: RV64 translation and memory request admission
slices.action: 只在 H4 被 owner-correlated 区间支持后，选择 reservation、translation 或 SQ query 中的一个最小瓶颈切片。
required_evidence: candidate objective observation with confidence interval
translation/order/permission directed tests
full performance A/B plus quick synth/STA
success_conditions: target interval shrinks without shifting equal debt downstream
permission, order and replay semantics remain exact
rollback_conditions: memory ordering or permission evidence regresses
critical path consumes the 5 ns reserve
forbidden_claims: aggregate memory_latency proves translation is causal

slices.title: 校正 transaction frequency 与 ROB-head residency 权重
slices.action: 若 H3 成立，先修正解释和候选排名，不以扩大数据通路作为默认动作。
required_evidence: transaction-count versus duration decomposition
updated hypothesis authorization receipt
success_conditions: residency attribution no longer masquerades as recoverable CPI
forbidden_claims: measurement correction is an RTL CPI improvement
